title: Local Minimax Estimation of Conditional Optimal Transport Bounds from Cross-Arm Covariate Collisions
banked_reason: D0.5.G graded the structured collision frontier subfield below the field floor (paper-score ceiling 6.6 < 7.4; salvageable=false); math review passes, but broader-class achievability and the promised lambda=1 rational certificate artifact are not delivered.
gap_reasons: The note proves two-sided finite-information minimax transfer, honest-length transfer, and a matching ordered local-minimax variance only for the known-amplitude, uniform-cell deterministic-sign experiment.
For general anchor-containing COT classes it proves converse lower bounds only, while continuous achievability is restricted to the specially constructed growing-roughness interpolation image.

The node gives a general LP-certification scheme but does not exhibit the required λ=1 doubled-resolution rational primal/dual enclosure (with its coverage-segment check and comparison to the exact one-mark control), so the promised independently usable finite certificate is not yet delivered.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery established the sharp finite-array endpoint, marked-Poisson comparison, finite-information risk and honest-length transfers, sparse Gaussian inference, and the ordered deterministic-shell local-minimax lower bound; the final bounded repair pass cleared every math-panel finding. The result remained below the field floor because achievability does not extend to the broad anchor COT class and no coarsening-bias refinement theory was supplied; the promised explicit λ=1 rational primal/dual certificate and segmentwise coverage artifact also remains undelivered.
tldr: For binary outcomes on a growing uniform covariate partition, the sharp absolute-cost COT lower endpoint is \(L_K=a-b\rho_K\), where \(\rho_K\) is the realized correlation of two deterministic sign arrays. When \(\lambda_K=n_0n_1/K\) remains finite and triple collisions vanish, a Poisson number of cross-arm collisions carries the minimax information: parameter-free supported-mixture kernels and a uniform deterministic-array approximation yield exact minimax absolute-risk and honest-length transfer, with shrinking rational interval-action certificates and explicit tail, off-grid coverage, and rounding errors. When \(\lambda_K\) diverges sparsely, the unprojected estimator is uniformly studentized Gaussian and the deterministic-shell local minimax theorem gives the matching interior variance frontier. Embedding cell \(j\) as \(j/K\) transfers the finite frontiers and, through pointwise shell inclusion followed by the ordered lower limits, the local variance as converse lower bounds to every anchor-admissible containing class. No broader-class upper bound is claimed; continuous achievability remains confined to the declared growing-roughness interpolation image.
gap: Published COT theory supplies sharp identification, consistency, rates, model-agnostic conservative inference, and smooth quadratic-cost inference through Proposition~3.2's key estimation bound, Proposition~3.3's quadratic-objective stability inequality, and Theorem~3.2's central limit theorem, but it does not characterize the non-Gaussian information experiment created by sparse cross-arm replication on a growing partition. Large-alphabet collision theory and confidence-set duality supply techniques, not the two-arm marked endpoint or legal deterministic-array transfer.
fill: The project proves a marked-Poisson reduction with parameter-free forward and reverse randomization on an explicit interior correlation lattice under shell-conditioned legal product mixtures, derives uniform collision-statistic approximation for every deterministic array, and certifies honest finite-information intervals by exactly checked rational lower-dual and upper-primal witnesses with explicit Poisson-tail and continuum-coverage corrections. It resolves the remaining LAN-to-shell lower bound before transferring only after a measurable coarsening pushforward from an explicit uniform-covariate interpolation image.
